prompt: Someone filed this complaint about our crawler (crawler.py): "Crawls are slow to finish and our test site's fake server logs way more hits than there are actual pages -- feels like it's hammering the same page repeatedly. Also I swear I saw a traceback flash by once but the crawl 'finished successfully' and the report showed no errors at all, so now I don't trust the report." Figure out what's actually wrong and fix it. crawler.py's docstring says what correct behavior should be (respect max_concurrency, visit each normalized URL exactly once, never lose a fetch failure). There's a starter test_crawler.py with a couple of basic cases -- it already passes even on the current buggy code, since it doesn't happen to trigger any of the bugs, so don't treat it as proof things are fixed.
